nodes.description: Administrator address payable for the contract, used for access control across admin functions.
Pending administrator address awaiting acceptance via _acceptAdmin.
ComptrollerInterface reference overseeing inter-cToken operations and policy hooks.
Interest rate model contract used to compute borrow/supply rates.
Initial exchange rate used when totalSupply is zero.
Fraction of accrued interest set aside as reserves.
Block number at which interest was last accrued; used for freshness checks.
Global accumulated borrow interest index since market opening.
Total outstanding borrows of underlying in the market.
Total reserves of underlying held by the market.
Total number of cTokens in circulation.
Mapping of account address to cToken / token balances.
Nested mapping of owner to spender approved transfer amounts.
Mapping of account address to BorrowSnapshot principal and interest index.
Reentrancy guard boolean used by the nonReentrant modifier.
Price oracle providing underlying asset prices for liquidity calculations.
Maximum fraction of a borrow that may be repaid in a single liquidation.
Discount multiplier granted to liquidators.
Mapping of cToken address to Market metadata including listing and collateral factor.
Per-market borrow caps enforced in borrowAllowed.
Per-market supply caps enforced in mintAllowed.
Per-protocol credit limit allowing uncollateralized borrow and repay.
Address allowed to pause mint, borrow, transfer, seize and flashloan actions.
Underlying ERC-20 asset address for the CErc20 market.
Collateral cap for the collateral-cap cToken, zero for no cap.
Initializes the money market: comptroller, interest rate model, exchange rate, name, symbol, decimals.
External nonReentrant transfer of cTokens from msg.sender to dst.
External nonReentrant transfer of cTokens from src to dst using caller allowance.
Approves spender to transfer up to amount of the caller's cTokens.
Accrues interest from the last checkpointed block to the current block and writes new storage checkpoints.
Computes the exchange rate from underlying to cToken from stored values.
Core borrow logic: comptroller check, cash check, balance updates and doTransferOut.
Core repay logic: comptroller check, doTransferIn and borrow balance reduction.
Core liquidation logic: repay borrow then seize collateral from borrower.
External nonReentrant entry point that seizes collateral using msg.sender as seizer token.
Internal collateral transfer between accounts with comptroller seizeAllowed check.
Admin-only function starting a transfer of admin rights to newPendingAdmin.
Acceptance of admin rights by pendingAdmin.
Admin-only setter of a new comptroller, validated by isComptroller marker.
Admin function accruing interest then updating the reserve factor.
Admin function accruing interest then transferring reserves to admin.
Admin function accruing interest then updating the interest rate model.
Policy hook validating mint, enforcing market listing, pause and supply caps.
Policy hook validating borrow, enforcing listing, oracle price, borrow caps and liquidity.
Internal redeem validation performing hypothetical liquidity checks.
Policy hook validating liquidation, enforcing shortfall and close factor.
Policy hook validating seize, enforcing pause, listing and comptroller match.
Policy hook validating cToken transfers via redeemAllowedInternal.
Computes account collateral, borrow effects and shortfall across entered markets.
Computes collateral tokens to seize given a repay amount using oracle prices and exchange rate.
Admin-only listing of a new cToken market.
Admin-only removal of a cToken market from the markets mapping.
Admin or supply cap guardian sets supply caps for markets.
Admin or borrow cap guardian sets borrow caps for markets.
Accepts the implementation role from a Unitroller by calling _acceptImplementation.
Delegates votes via EIP-712 signature using ecrecover, nonce and expiry.
Internal token balance transfer that also moves vote delegates.
Modifier guarding against direct or indirect reentrant calls using _notEntered.
Unitroller fallback that delegatecalls into comptrollerImplementation with msg.data.
Caller identity, attacker controllable, used extensively for authorization and transfers.
Timestamp of the current block, used for signature expiry in delegateBySig.
Original transaction sender, a phishing-prone authorization source.
Abstract external underlying transfer out; interacts with arbitrary token, reverting on failure.
Unchecked delegatecall to comptrollerImplementation forwarding caller data and return data.
External call to seize collateral on another cToken market during liquidation.
Signature recovery used in delegateBySig; malleable and must be validated.
Abstract external underlying transfer in used by repay and add reserves flows.
External oracle price call whose zero result is treated as price error.
borrowAmount parameter of borrowInternal and borrowFresh.
repayAmount parameter of repayBorrowFresh and liquidation flows.
dst destination address parameter of transfer and transferFrom.
account parameter of liquidity and snapshot queries.
BorrowLocalVars struct holding accountBorrows, accountBorrowsNew and totalBorrowsNew.
newReserveFactorMantissa parameter of _setReserveFactor and _setReserveFactorFresh.
Locally computed exchange rate in exchangeRateStoredInternal.
nonce parameter of delegateBySig checked against stored nonces.

edges.reason: initialize requires msg.sender == admin, so the caller identity gates initialization of the market.
The admin state variable is read to authorize the initialize call.
initialize writes accrualBlockNumber from getBlockNumber.
initialize sets borrowIndex to mantissaOne.
initialize sets the reentrancy guard _notEntered to true.
initialize sets the comptroller via _setComptroller.
initialize sets the interest rate model via _setInterestRateModelFresh.
transfer passes msg.sender as both spender and source of the token movement.
transfer ultimately triggers doTransferOut on external token contracts, a reentrancy surface guarded by nonReentrant.
transfer is protected by the nonReentrant modifier reading _notEntered.
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner.
approve writes the allowance into transferAllowances.
accrueInterest reads and rewrites accrualBlockNumber to compute the elapsed block delta.
accrueInterest updates borrowIndex using simpleInterestFactor arithmetic.
accrueInterest adds interestAccumulated to totalBorrows.
accrueInterest updates totalReserves with reserve factor arithmetic.
accrueInterest calls interestRateModel.getBorrowRate externally.
exchangeRateStoredInternal divides by totalSupply and uses sub_/add_ arithmetic.
exchangeRateStoredInternal computes the local exchangeRate value.
borrowFresh calls comptroller.borrowAllowed, an external policy check controlling the borrow.
borrowFresh invokes doTransferOut for the borrower, the classic reentrancy interaction point.
borrowFresh writes principal and interestIndex into accountBorrows.
borrowFresh computes totalBorrowsNew with add_ and stores it in totalBorrows.
borrowAmount flows into add_ additions for the new account and total borrows.
BorrowLocalVars holds the intermediate borrow balance computations that can overflow.
repayBorrowFresh calls doTransferIn on the payer, an external token interaction before state writes.
repayAmount is compared against uint256(-1) and used in sub_ balance reductions.
repayBorrowFresh writes the reduced principal and updated interestIndex.
liquidateBorrowFresh makes an external seize call to another cToken collateral market.
liquidateBorrowFresh calls comptroller.liquidateCalculateSeizeTokens for the seize amount.
repayAmount flows into the liquidation repay path and seize calculation.
seize deliberately uses msg.sender as the seizer token, critical for in-kind liquidation security.
seize delegates to seizeInternal with msg.sender as seizerToken.
seizeInternal adjusts account token balances of borrower and liquidator.
_setPendingAdmin checks msg.sender against admin before changing state.
_setPendingAdmin writes newPendingAdmin into pendingAdmin.
_acceptAdmin requires msg.sender == pendingAdmin for privilege escalation to admin.
_acceptAdmin promotes pendingAdmin into admin.
_acceptAdmin resets pendingAdmin to address(0).
_setComptroller reverts via fail if msg.sender is not admin.
_setComptroller stores newComptroller into the comptroller variable.
_setReserveFactor accrues interest before changing the reserve factor.
_setReserveFactorFresh writes newReserveFactorMantissa into reserveFactorMantissa.
newReserveFactorMantissa is bounded against reserveFactorMaxMantissa before being stored.
_reduceReservesFresh requires msg.sender == admin and transfers funds to admin.
_reduceReservesFresh subtracts reduceAmount from totalReserves using sub_.
_setInterestRateModelFresh writes the new model into interestRateModel.
_setInterestRateModelFresh rejects callers other than admin.
mintAllowed reads supplyCaps for the market to enforce the supply cap.
mintAllowed checks markets[cToken].isListed before allowing a mint.
borrowAllowed reads borrowCaps to cap total borrows.
borrowAllowed queries the oracle price and rejects zero prices.
redeemAllowedInternal performs a hypothetical liquidity check for the redeemer.
redeemAllowedInternal consults markets accountMembership and listing state.
liquidateBorrowAllowed multiplies borrowBalance by closeFactorMantissa to bound repayAmount.
seizeAllowed verifies both markets are listed and share the same comptroller.
transferAllowed delegates to redeemAllowedInternal for the source account.
getHypotheticalAccountLiquidityInternal calls the oracle for each entered asset price.
creditLimits can override collateral checks and short-circuit liquidity enforcement.
The account parameter drives snapshot reads and credit limit lookups.
liquidateCalculateSeizeTokens reads borrowed and collateral prices from the oracle.
_supportMarket requires msg.sender == admin before listing a market.
_supportMarket writes the Market struct into the markets mapping.
_delistMarket requires msg.sender == admin before deleting a market.
_setMarketSupplyCaps authorizes admin or supplyCapGuardian then writes supplyCaps.
_setMarketBorrowCaps authorizes admin or borrowCapGuardian then writes borrowCaps.
_become interacts with the Unitroller upgrade mechanism that controls delegatecall target.
delegateBySig recovers a signatory with ecrecover and requires a valid nonce and expiry.
delegateBySig compares block.timestamp against the signature expiry, a timestamp dependency.
The nonce parameter is checked against nonces[signatory] to prevent signature replay.
_transferTokens subtracts from src and adds to dst token balances.
The nonReentrant modifier toggles _notEntered to block reentrant entry.
The Unitroller fallback delegatecalls msg.data into comptrollerImplementation.
Oracle price values feed directly into collateral and borrow effect computations.
doTransferOut occurs before borrow storage writes, so reentrancy could observe stale totalBorrows.
The external seize transfers collateral balances, a cross-market reentrancy vector.
tx.origin should never authorize privileged operations; included to flag origin-based trust surfaces.
repayAmount reaches the liquidation flow and bounds the repaid debt.
The dst parameter flows into the outbound token transfer.
borrowAmount flows from the borrow call into doTransferOut to the borrower.
